number.why: The reconstruction is arithmetically correct: assuming the allocated arms are the outcome denominators and ordinary whole-percent rounding, 71/111 and 82/114 uniquely reproduce 64% and 72%. Their derived OR is approximately 0.692683. These are reconstructed counts, not explicitly reported counts or a published OR. The reported effect is a risk difference of -8% with a 95% CI of -20% to 4%; that interval must not be attached to the OR. The held text does not establish the served analysis population or end-of-treatment timepoint.

quotes.span: The primary outcome measure was ovulation.
111 women were allocated to clomifene citrate plus metformin (metformin group) and 114 women were allocated to clomifene citrate plus placebo (placebo group).
The ovulation rate in the metformin group was 64% compared with 72% in the placebo group, a non-significant difference (risk difference - 8%, 95% confidence interval - 20% to 4%).

entry.why: The source directly establishes women with PCOS receiving clomifene ovulation induction in a randomised comparison of added metformin versus placebo, matching the packet question.

quotes.span: Effect of clomifene citrate plus metformin and clomifene citrate plus placebo on induction of ovulation in women with newly diagnosed polycystic ovary syndrome: randomised double blind clinical trial.
INTERVENTIONS: Clomifene citrate plus metformin or clomifene citrate plus placebo.

missed: The participant total is not reconciled with the allocated arms: cache/metformin-pcos-ovulation/records.json#/records/39 states "PARTICIPANTS: 228 women with polycystic ovary syndrome." The quoted allocations total 225, so they do not independently prove an all-randomised analysis. This limits population verification without disproving the conditional count reconstruction. The packet also supports ISRCTN registration, not the served description 'NCT-registered': the same source states "TRIAL REGISTRATION: Current Controlled Trials ISRCTN55906981 [controlled-trials.com]." No registry-parent text is included in the packet; entry eligibility is nevertheless established by the article itself.
